components.complexity_rationale: SSR storefront + admin; consumes all four service contracts; owns session/token handling and UX from S1.5.
Credentials + rotating refresh-token families; no upstream deps.
Atomic reservation under the last-item race + TTL sweep; consumes payment/status events.
Server-side totals, coupon, idempotent confirm, mock PSP; sync-orchestrates reserve+create (ADR-007/008).
Immutable snapshots + forward-only fulfillment state machine; consumes payment events.

contracts.idempotency_rules: Not idempotent by design; rate-limited; each login issues a new session pair.
Single-use token keyed on refresh_token_id; concurrent refresh yields exactly one rotation, others fail closed.
Keyed on confirm_id; atomic conditional decrement; retry reserves once; already-reserved returns existing.
contracts.ordering_guarantees: Synchronous; atomic decrement serializes the last-item race.

contracts.idempotency_rules: Keyed on reservation_id; release once; already-released is a no-op.
Each adjustment is a distinct intentional entry; guarded by a current-state precondition (no below-reserved).
Client idempotency_key; duplicate confirm returns the same order; no second order/reservation; crash-safe via ADR-008.
Dedupe on provider_event_id; duplicate provider callback applies once; captured amount must equal the server total.
Idempotent on confirm_id; duplicate returns the existing order; snapshots frozen at creation; safe to retry (ADR-008).
Guarded by current-state precondition; re-submitting the same transition no-ops; forward-only.

contracts.ordering_guarantees: Kafka partition key = audit_id (per-run FIFO); at-least-once + idempotent consumers; published via transactional outbox (ADR-008).
Kafka partition key = audit_id; at-least-once + idempotent consumers; via outbox (ADR-008).

infra_summary.content: 5 containerized services; per-service MySQL (no shared DB); Redis; Kafka with per-service transactional outbox; mock PSP/courier; ap-southeast (TH/SG) residency; GitLab CI per repo. Full doc at path.

infra_topology.content: One-screen ASCII topology: web → 4 services (sync) → per-service MySQL/Redis; checkout → inventory/order (sync) + mock-psp; outbox → Kafka (audit_id-keyed) → inventory/order consumers. Full doc at path.

connectivity.content: From/To/Kind/Contract matrix for every sync call and event flow; mTLS intra-cluster; all events via per-service outbox. Full doc at path.

observability_spec.content: slog JSON (no PII/token/PAN); append-only audit {event,actor,ts,before,after,outcome,audit_id}; RED + domain SLO metrics (stock-mismatch/double-charge targets 0); audit_id trace; alerts on stock<0, outbox lag, DLQ. Numeric latency SLOs are TBD-confirm-with-PM. Full doc at path.

adrs.content: Polyrepo, one service per bounded context; no shared DB; sync HTTP + Kafka.
Reserve at confirm via sync idempotent atomic conditional decrement; 30-min TTL; resolves the last-item race to one winner.
Order freezes price/items/address snapshot at creation; catalog edits never drift a placed order.
No distributed rollback; failure paths emit compensating release; unpaid reservations auto-release on TTL.
Mock PSP behind client_psp gateway in checkout-service only; no PAN/CVV; one-adapter swap to a real PSP.
Cross-cutting append-only audit keyed by audit_id; per-service table + shared topic; retention 5y/1y.

MVP: no standalone Orchestrator for the single checkout journey; checkout-service orchestrates synchronously. Deviation accepted; revisit on a 2nd cross-context journey. Recorded in architecture_smells.
Added in the S2.5 loop-back (RT-2): transactional outbox per producing service + idempotent order.create/capture retry close the dual-write gap and the partial-failure window; TTL is the backstop.

api_specs.content: auth-service v1.0: register, login, refresh, logout; emits auth.session.* / auth.family.revoked.
inventory-service v1.0: reserve, release, admin adjust; consumes order.payment.captured/status.changed; emits stock.*.
checkout-service v1.0: confirm, capture; calls inventory.reserve/release + order.create; emits order.purchase.created/payment.captured; PCI boundary.
order-service v1.0: create, get (own-data-only), admin transition; consumes order.payment.captured; emits order.status.changed.

l4_specs.content: Authenticate customer; issue access+refresh; generic failure; no credential/token in logs.

command.name: AuthenticateCustomer
command.intent: Verify credentials and issue a session pair

events_emitted.name: auth.session.issued
events_emitted.when: A valid login issues a session pair

l4_specs.content: Rotate session; single-use refresh; replay revokes the family.

events_emitted.name: auth.session.rotated
events_emitted.when: A valid refresh rotates the pair

events_emitted.name: auth.family.revoked
events_emitted.when: A replayed refresh token is detected

l4_specs.content: Confirm order at a server-computed total; idempotent; reserve then create.

command.name: ConfirmOrder
command.intent: Server-compute the total and create an awaiting-payment order with reserved stock

events_emitted.name: order.purchase.created
events_emitted.when: An order is created in awaiting-payment

l4_specs.content: Capture mock payment; dedupe on provider event id; failure releases stock.

command.name: CaptureMockPayment
command.intent: Capture payment via the mock PSP gateway

l4_specs.content: Track own order; immutable snapshot; non-owner denied.

command.name: GetOwnOrder
command.intent: Return the owner's order snapshot and timeline

l4_specs.no_event_rationale: Read-only query with own-data-only authz; no state mutation, so no domain event is emitted.

l4_specs.content: Advance fulfillment; forward-only; shipped requires tracking; idempotent.

command.name: AdvanceFulfillment
command.intent: Move an order forward through the fulfillment state machine

events_emitted.name: order.status.changed
events_emitted.when: A valid forward transition is accepted

l4_specs.content: Reserve stock atomically; last-item race → one winner; TTL release.

events_emitted.name: stock.unit.reserved
events_emitted.when: Units are held for a confirm

l4_specs.content: Admin adjust stock with mandatory reason; never below reserved; audited.

command.name: AdjustStock
command.intent: Adjust available stock with a reason

event_catalog.content: Split catalog: 9 domain events (auth.session.issued/rotated, auth.family.revoked, order.purchase.created, order.payment.captured, order.status.changed, stock.unit.reserved/released, stock.level.adjusted); 0 process events (no Orchestrator, ADR-007). Partition key audit_id; at-least-once + idempotent. Full doc at path.

coverage_gaps.detail: STORY-ORDER-02, STORY-INVENTORY-01, STORY-INVENTORY-02 are admin/back-office or system-driven; no customer UX route by design (carried from S1.5).
/, /products/:sku and /cart are implied by checkout but have no dedicated BA story (carried from S1.5; flagged for BA).

architecture_smells.check: Contexts split by business workstream, not tech layer
Each aggregate owns one consistency boundary; no god-aggregate
Domain logic in the domain layer, not handlers (no anemic domain)
Every component dependency resolves to a named contract (no orphans)
Events split domain vs process; no orphan events

open_questions.question: Does the customer confirm delivery, or does only the admin mark an order delivered?
open_questions.why_matters: Adding customer-confirmed delivery introduces a new flow + notification and changes the order state machine; deferred but affects ORDER scope if pulled forward.

open_questions.question: What is the abandoned-cart handling beyond the 30-day purge (notify vs silent purge)?
open_questions.why_matters: Affects the cart-abandonment KPI and a possible future reminder notification; not blocking for the MVP.

open_questions.question: What are the numeric SLO thresholds for order-confirm p95 and order-listing latency?
open_questions.why_matters: S1 §3 names these success signals but gives no numeric targets; the observability alerts and a meaningful gate need concrete thresholds.
